reading.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
reading.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

news.title: Reddit and libertarian group challenge Australia’s under-16s social media ban in high court
news.summary: Social network and Digital Freedom Project, led by NSW state MP John Ruddick, seek to overturn ban on grounds of implied freedom of political communication Australia’s world-leading under-16s social media ban will face its first major legal challenge on Tuesday, as Reddit and an advocacy group headed by a libertarian politician seek to overturn the law in the high court. Nearly 11 months ago, 10 platforms – Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Kick, X, Twitch and Threads – were required to deactivate or suspend the accounts of users they determined to be aged under 16 years.
